assumptions.source: synthetic prescribed sensor traces; Python controller
assumptions.filter: up to five valid samples; cleared on fault
assumptions.transport: in-process latest-snapshot surrogate; not an MQTT benchmark
assumptions.plant: no water balance, soil physics, rain or yield model
assumptions.timing: discrete 1-second software clock; not ESP32 latency

metrics.scope: Held-out public dataset with engineered rainfall/humidity moisture proxy; not measured-soil or field accuracy.
